parameters.question: The dataset under analysis pertains to non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) and contains 1,901 cells and 36,601 genes. After quality control and preprocessing, 96.4% of cells and 71.2% of genes were retained, indicating a high-quality dataset with minimal noise. These clusters should guide the selection of marker genes, with a focus on identifying unique markers for the largest cell populations to ensure accurate cell typing. no no

CD4+ T cells.rationale: CD4 is a canonical marker for CD4+ T cells. IL2, IFNG, and TNF are cytokines commonly produced by this cell type. CD8A and CD19 are markers for CD8+ T cells and B cells, respectively, and are not expressed in CD4+ T cells.

CD8+ T cells.rationale: CD8A and CD8B are canonical markers for CD8+ T cells. GZMB and PRF1 are cytotoxic molecules commonly produced by this cell type. CD4 and CD19 are markers for CD4+ T cells and B cells, respectively, and are not expressed in CD8+ T cells.

Regulatory T cells.rationale: FOXP3 is a canonical marker for regulatory T cells. CTLA4, IL2RA, and TGFBR1 are associated with the suppressive function of this cell type. CD8A and CD19 are markers for CD8+ T cells and B cells, respectively, and are not expressed in regulatory T cells.

B cells.rationale: CD19, CD79A, MS4A1, and IGHD are canonical markers for B cells. CD3D and CD14 are markers for T cells and monocytes, respectively, and are not expressed in B cells.

Plasma cells.rationale: CD138, XBP1, IGHG1, and IGHA1 are canonical markers for plasma cells. CD19 and CD3D are markers for B cells and T cells, respectively, and are not expressed in plasma cells.

NK cells.rationale: NCAM1, NKG7, PRF1, and GZMB are canonical markers for NK cells. CD3D and CD19 are markers for T cells and B cells, respectively, and are not expressed in NK cells.

Monocytes/macrophages.rationale: CD14, CD68, CD163, and CSF1R are canonical markers for monocytes/macrophages. CD3D and CD19 are markers for T cells and B cells, respectively, and are not expressed in monocytes/macrophages.

Dendritic cells.rationale: CD11C, CD209, HLA-DRA, and CCR7 are canonical markers for dendritic cells. CD3D and CD19 are markers for T cells and B cells, respectively, and are not expressed in dendritic cells.

Endothelial cells.rationale: PECAM1, CDH5, VEGFR2, and VWF are canonical markers for endothelial cells. CD45 and EPCAM are markers for hematopoietic and epithelial cells, respectively, and are not expressed in endothelial cells.

Fibroblasts / CAFs.rationale: ACTA2, COL1A1, FAP, and PDGFRB are canonical markers for fibroblasts/CAFs. CD45 and EPCAM are markers for hematopoietic and epithelial cells, respectively, and are not expressed in fibroblasts/CAFs.

Pericytes.rationale: PDGFRB, RGS5, NG2, and CD146 are canonical markers for pericytes. CD45 and EPCAM are markers for hematopoietic and epithelial cells, respectively, and are not expressed in pericytes.

Mast cells.rationale: KIT, FCER1A, CPA3, and TPSAB1 are canonical markers for mast cells. CD3D and CD19 are markers for T cells and B cells, respectively, and are not expressed in mast cells.
